newsitem.title: USA: Arbitrator approves LVMH's DFS purchase.
newsitem.headline: Arbitrator approves LVMH's DFS purchase.

text.p: DFS Group Ltd said Tuesday an arbitrator determined LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton's proposed purchase of a majority of DFS equity could proceed, if parties agreed to conditions protecting DFS's independence.
LMVH agreed to these provisions, DFS said, and was proceeding to complete the transaction.
The conditions included LMVH signing an agreement guaranteeing DFS's long-term autonomy.
LMVH made a bid for a 59 percent stake in the U.S. duty-free goods group. Investment house Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co has also sent DFS shareholders a letter of interest, LMVH said.
